records.academicNote: ONE degree with two platform CONDITION VIEWS, not formal university specialisations: standard English requirements, or explicitly described REGIONAL/NATIONAL elite-athlete consideration. Standard academic entry is sports/closely related bachelor OR assessed local/regional/national elite-athlete bachelor/equivalent. Only REGIONAL/NATIONAL elite athletes have the stated limited-quota English exception, determined by interview plus a required additional SELF-FUNDED English enhancement course if selected. records.documentNote: October 2026 central checklist distinguishes final-year/graduate/qualification-location documents, applicable language evidence, conditional CHSI/CSCSE/HKCAAVQ and certified English translation. Original documents are normally not required at application; official direct transmission may be requested before offer confirmation/registration. The platform collects no private documents. Programme specifies a TWO-PAGE personal statement; a TWO-PAGE CV in ONE PDF; sports/health supporting documents in ONE PDF IF APPLICABLE; regional/national elite-athlete proof IF APPLICABLE. The CV one-PDF instruction does not mean statement and CV must be combined. Do not turn page limits into word counts. Elite consideration needs actual proof, quota/interview assessment and self-funded English enhancement, not self-certified exemption.

records.academicNote: Recognised bachelor in psychology, nursing, education, social work, health-related programmes OR assessed equivalent. Shortlisted candidates MUST interview. FT 1.5 YEARS / PT 2 YEARS, not a one-year FT master. Core teaching can occur Monday-Saturday 9:30-17:30 over two consecutive weeks per block; PT is not guaranteed evening/weekend-only. Prior PTUK-related certificates within/over five years affect credit transfer/practicum exemption, not ordinary admission or automatic tuition discounts. Further study may be needed for play-therapist professional recognition.

boundaries.identity: Only current P034 and P057 link records updated with exact before/after archive. Old October raw inventory unchanged. STEM Chinese old URL loops; actual replacement was observed in official English-page links, not guessed. Athlete conditions are platform views of one degree, not formal university streams.
boundaries.academic: Mathematics preparation not a mandatory maths degree; AI requires programming evidence; PersonalFinance welcomes non-finance and documents2027/28 retitling; no numeric entry GPA inferred from rank/transfer/professional conditions.
boundaries.languages: Six independent EN/ZH snapshots plus two standard/elite Sports views. HSK6 condition is BOTH non-Chinese native AND no Chinese-medium degree. Regional/national elite English exception is interview/quota assessed, not guaranteed or extended to local elite. BAFT requires English max1000wordSOP despite Chinese instruction.
boundaries.fees: All nine panels explicitly label2027/28 or2027 cohort amounts. PT whole fees not doubled; scholarships/credit transfers not deducted; athlete self-funded English course has unknown extra cost. Two proposed prices remain approval-pending.
boundaries.dates: Central September2027 category rounds, with TPWB programme-specific confirming dates. Proposed programmes stay admissionRoute unconfirmed and timeline-unverified, even though future calendar values are retained for reference.
boundaries.modes: FT-only EfS/STEM headline and duration retained; stray English C2 codes do not prove current PT availability. TPWB full-time is1.5years, part-time2years with daytime two-week core blocks. No guaranteed evening-only study.
boundaries.documents: Sports2page statement and2page CV-in-onePDF are separate instructions; math transcripts/exam equivalents and elite proof are conditional; BAFT1000WORDS notcharacters. Original private documents not collected.
